title: Ooty (Batch 2)
selection: Batch 2. Ooty had 6 sections; this adds who it's for, practical info (including the Nilgiris vehicle e-pass), food, shopping, festivals and common mistakes, a fuller overview (pending review) and rewrites the thin ooty-3-days itinerary (moved here from tamil-nadu.json). Not covered: entry fees and toy-train fares. Note: Botanical Garden date (1897 vs 1842) and Doddabetta height (2,637 vs 2,623 m) differ between sources; neither number is used here.

overview.text:
Udhagamandalam, better known as Ooty, sits at about 2,240 m in the Nilgiri Mountains of the Western Ghats. Tamil Nadu Tourism calls it the Queen of Hill Stations. The British turned it into a summer retreat, and the town is still cool all year, with summer days of about 10–25 °C and winter nights that can touch freezing.

The best-known way up is the Nilgiri Mountain Railway, a UNESCO-listed toy train that takes nearly five hours from Mettupalayam. In town are the Botanical Garden, which holds the Flower Show each May, Ooty Lake and India's largest rose garden. Doddabetta, the highest peak in the Nilgiris, is about 10 km away, Pykara's falls about 19 km and Coonoor 21 km. Ooty lies inside the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, and tea estates, Toda villages and pine forests are all close. It suits families, couples and anyone escaping the heat of the plains.

items.body: Coimbatore airport (about 88 km) and Coimbatore railway station (about 87 km), then by road up the ghats or the toy train from Mettupalayam via Coonoor.

items.title: Driving in: e-pass
items.body: Tourist vehicles not registered in the Nilgiris need an e-pass from epass.tnega.org before reaching the checkpost. Daily caps have applied in peak months, so apply as soon as your dates are fixed and check the current rules.

items.title: Buses

plan.overview: The classic way into the Nilgiris: up on the toy train, a day in town, and a day out to Doddabetta and Pykara. It suits families and first-timers, and needs no car.
plan.season: Any time. Tamil Nadu Tourism names March–June as best; October–March is peak season. Both monsoons bring heavy rain.
plan.transport: Toy train up; taxis or buses in and around Ooty

days.title: Up the Nilgiris on the toy train
days.summary: Get to Mettupalayam early, then ride the Nilgiri Mountain Railway up through Coonoor. Spend the evening walking in town.

stops.name: Nilgiri Mountain Railway, Mettupalayam to Ooty

days.travel: Coimbatore to Mettupalayam by road or train, then the toy train.
days.meals: Breakfast before boarding; dinner in town, with homemade chocolates to finish.

days.title: Garden, tea and the lake
days.summary: A day in and around town, all within easy taxi range.
days.travel: Short taxi or auto hops in town.
days.meals: Lunch near the garden; tea and pastries at an old bakery.

days.title: Doddabetta and Pykara
days.summary: Go up Doddabetta early before the clouds build, then drive out to Pykara's falls and lake.
days.travel: Hire a taxi for the day.
days.distance: Doddabetta about 10 km; Pykara about 19 km from Ooty
days.meals: Pack snacks for Pykara; dinner back in Ooty.

budget.assumptions: VacayOut has no verified current prices for Ooty hotels, taxis, toy-train tickets or entry fees. Budget for your own choices and check fees at each site.

booking.detail: Book on Indian Railways as early as you can; seats sell out in season.
Only if you drive in: apply at epass.tnega.org before reaching the Nilgiris.

alternatives: Driving instead of the train: apply for the e-pass, and use day 1 for Coonoor (21 km) on the way up.
With a spare day: Mudumalai National Park, about 31 km away.
In May: time day 2 for the Flower Show at the Botanical Garden.
tips: Carry layers: winter nights can drop to near freezing.
Visit viewpoints in the morning before cloud rolls in.
